# Salvage Lead
1. Your direct superior is the Quartermaster.
2. The Salvage Lead is responsible for ensuring all salvage technicians are accounted for during off station salvage trips.
3. The Salvage Lead must inform the Quartermaster when the salvage team is leaving for a planetary expedition.
4. It is the responsibility of the Salvage Lead to ensure adequate emergency medical supplies are on the salvage shuttle.
5. The Salvage Lead is to ensure that supplies from salvage expeditions are being brought back to the Cargo Bay for proper distribution.
6. The Salvage Lead is to have an accurate record of the station’s coordinates for emergency extravehicular situations.
7. The Salvage Lead is responsible for piloting the salvage shuttle, or assigning the duty to a willing salvage technician.
8. Salvage Leads are to report irreparable shuttle damages to the engineering team for immediate repair. Failure to have the ship repaired within 10 minutes is a breach of the Engineering Team’s SOP.
9. Any and all relevant SOP of standard Salvage Technicians pertains to the Salvage Lead.
